summary: test_memo_launch_fields_are_labeled_visible_and_stay_within_64_columns opens the real modal via keypresses, asserts focus is still on MemoTextArea, then checks all three labels by exact text, non-default resolved values (codex/terra/high from repo default terra:high), and region.width>0 per control — each conjunct's violation (missing control, blank/app-default values, appear-on-focus) would fail
